notes: No Objective. Strategy: start Endor: Forest Clearing and Prepared Defenses (with Crossfire, An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops, Secret Plans); all are in the list. Prepared Defenses names no single starting Effect, so starting effect is left empty.

The posted list is wrapped at about 30 characters: 'Elite Squadron / Stormtrooper x3', 'Victory-class Star / Destroyer x2', 'Setinel-class Landing / Craft x2' and 'An Entire Legion Of My Best / Troops' are one card each; section headers mis-parsed as cards were removed.
Posted update (4/23/01): 'Take out the Stormtroopers x3 and make them elite squadron stormtroopers x3'. The list as posted already reads Elite Squadron Stormtrooper x3 and Stormtrooper x7.
Dark pages used: Blaster Rifle (Dark), Disruptor Pistol (Dark), Concussion Missiles (Dark) (posted 'Concusion Missle'), Endor: Back Door (Dark), Endor: Ewok Village (Dark).
Posted 'Ghhhk x2' dested Ghhhk; 'Freeze' dested Freeze!; 'Trooper Assult x5' dested Trooper Assault.
Secret Plans counted as an Effect (2001, Special Edition), in the list.
Total 58 as published (not 60); kept as posted.
